notes.title: 🥊 Real Boxing 2: Remastered – OUT NOW 🥊
notes.content:
Real Boxing 2: Remastered is officially OUT NOW!

Walk into the ring with enhanced visuals, smoother combat, and more ways to dominate the fight.

And for those who want it all, check out the Gold Edition, packed with extra content, gear, and bonuses to give your fighter the edge from the start. 💥

[previewyoutube=1dz6rICUhCE;full][/previewyoutube]

✅ Remastered graphics & rebalanced gameplay
✅ Fully customizable fighters – from muscle mass to outfits

Create your fighter, rise through the ranks, and show the world what you're made of.

notes.title: 🥊 Real Boxing 2: Remastered Punches In This August 4th!🥊
notes.content:
Get ready! Real Boxing 2: Remastered is launching on August 4th, 2025!

Whether you're still reeling from the Usyk vs. Dubois fight or just ready to throw some punches of your own, it's your time to shine. 💪


This isn’t just a visual upgrade. It’s a total knockout:

💥 Remastered graphics & fully rebalanced gameplay for a smoother, fairer fight

💥 Create your own fighter with full customization – from muscles to mohawks

💥 Mini-games to level up your skills and get fight-ready

💥 Boss battles with some... unexpected faces 👀 (Yes, even Santa)

💥 Career & multiplayer modes – rise through the ranks or fight your friends


[previewyoutube="fT1CZ4tmqM0;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
If you're looking for the glory, the fashion, or just to punch a clown in the face – this is your ring.

🔥 Wishlist now and prepare to enter the arena:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811350/Real_Boxing_2_Remastered/"][/dynamiclink]
